speaker: Arne Slot
quote_text:
Mitch, Arne, after the West Ham equaliser I guess  quite a relief when you get the win like that.  
I'll put the word quite out of this sentence.  It was a big relief because Ali made sure that  
they didn't score earlier. They had multiple  chances to score the one-one in the second-half.  
Unfortunately, they scored one, which they didn't  score, but we scored. And to be completely honest,  
it felt to me like, with five, I was expecting 2  minutes with maybe three or four months of at a  
time, but all of a sudden, 7 minutes were added  on. So we have no time wasting at all from both  
teams. It was a bit of a surprise for me. But  okay, it helped because we scored a goal an  
extra time. Was it extra time or was it in regular  time? Just before, just before. No, just before.  
So Yeah, of course, that was a relief because  to me it felt after West Ham scored and the way  
the second-half went, it was maybe more that we  could expect them scoring. But our fans and our  
players fought differently because from the moment  they scored the 1-1, we started playing again,  
we started pressing again, the fans were really  loud at that moment of time and already the chance  
from Luchito, some good counter press moments  which led to the corner kick and We shaved a big  
set piece for a very important moment because in  the morning game of football, set pieces, what is  
that important? And that's what we saw today again  as well. James. Virgil comes up with the winning  
goal, just underlines his importance to the club.  He's just said on TV that regarding his contracts,  
let's see the next week brings. Is there anything  you'd like to say about that? I think he means,  
let's see what next week means if we play  Leicester City. because that is at that moment  
of time by far the most important thing this  club is looking at. Two more wins and I think  
the first 32 games have shown us how difficult it  is, not only for us but for every team. I repeat,  
every team in the Premier League to win a game  of football. So the competition has never been as  
strong as it is this season and that's what makes  it so hard to win a game of football. So yeah,  
everybody can say, yeah, you have to  win too, yeah. We still have to win too,  
so we should be completely focused on that, and if  in the meantime, a contract extension or whatever  
happens, but my full focus is on on Leicester  and I'm sure Virgil's as well. So, it possibly be  
important to Alisson earlier on, Virgil obviously  gets at the moment of your first goal. I mean, how  
important is it, you know? these players who've  been around their experience to sort of over the  
next few weeks really help. Yeah, very important.  Would not be completely fair to only talk about  
them, but I think we're as a manager looking for  is always the ones that have achieved already a  
lot of things in their career that they step  up in the most important moments of the season.  
And I think it is always in the end of the season  moments getting bigger and bigger and bigger. And  
today all three of them showed up, not only these  three, but you're asking me about these three. In  
big moments, Alisson probably had his best game  of the season today. And Virgil saved, shaved,  
but he scored the header that got his three  points. And Mo was again very important in the  
first goal because, and he was really lively also  the first half. So I saw Mo Salah again from most  
parts of the season. The first thing that happened  that doesn't happen, but is that they also have  
players and that's what makes the Premier League  so strong this season. I think they're 16 or 17 in  
the league, but I can name one or two players that  could have easily played with us today as well  
in terms of quality. So that is where the Premier  League is about. And they used them more and more  
in the second-half, these two quality players, and  they have more, but I think Paquetá and Kudus were  
outstanding today, especially the second-half.  And maybe because we were 1-0 lap and we conceded  
one or two chances, it led to a situation where we  were a bit too afraid or didn't press hard enough  
anymore. It's them taking more and more risk,  bringing a lot of players into the midfield,  
and they still had their threats in the runs  with Bissaka, Bowen, and all the others. So  
yeah, it was a bit of both, but definitely credits  to West Ham as well. But you don't only see this  
here. I see this every game that I watch. I  don't watch every game of the Premier League,  
but the ones I do. I fought yesterday after  20 minutes. Oh, Crystal Palace is in a good  
place. And they could have scored 3-2, which  was fractionally offside, and they lost 5-2. So,  
these are the margins there are in the Premier  League, which makes it such a hard league to  
play in, but also why it's so popular. Can I  just ask about Darwin Núñez? Is he injured or  
for the reason he's not been involved in that?  No, he went in yesterday because he didn't he  
didn't feel well, so he went in, so that's why he  couldn't couldn't be in a team today. Will. Arne,  
yesterday you officially qualified next season's  Champions League. It's just what the club grows  
looking forward. When you came in, was that the  main aim of the August? Is that you said, Get us  
is the chance to lead, just as how important it  is? Do you feel like this is an overachievement?  
I think it's the main aim for the club, because  they've experienced 2 years ago how much of an  
impact it is if you are not a part of the Premier  League Champions League, sorry. So, yes, indeed.  
The main aim and what they told me is, yeah,  look at the players, give your opinion about it  
so we can go into this project in the second and  the first year, but do qualify for the Champions  
League. And we all know that even the team that is  at 16 at the moment has very good players, but the  
top eight is all of them have incredible players.  So it's getting more difficult and more difficult  
to qualify for the Champions League. So But to be  honest, if you were to ask this question to me in  
the beginning of the season, I would say, oh,  nice. But yesterday it wasn't I opened a bottle  
of wine because we qualified for the Champions  League. We have now, of course, a bigger aim than  
only qualifying for the Champions League. James.  The reaction from the fans after West Ham,  
was that one of the reasons you went into the Cup  afterwards to come as we've seen you after a game  
this season? Yeah, and I think because we won  the game of football where maybe for the first  
time this season, that you could debate if we  deserved to win this game. And then to win it  
at such a big moment where the fans helped  us, I think that deserves, or at least say,  
that's why I think I tried to show a bit more  how much I appreciate them for the whole season,  
but definitely today. Pete, last one. Is there a  good chance that you might win it here? How good  
would it be to win your first title on Liverpool?  Actually, I'm being burning around the atmosphere  
that would be tasty today. If I have to win it  15 kilometres from here, or I don't care where  
to win it, we know we still have to win two more  games, which is I was trying to come back to that  
every single time has been in 32 occasions  difficult enough for us. So first win two,  
And that's the only thing we should focus on.  And this week we should try to improve, improve,  
improve more and more to give ourselves a better  chance of winning a game of football next week  
where we face Leicester and everybody can talk,  talk, talk. But what I saw is that for the first  
time in 11 games they've scored two goals and  got a result. So they probably have a bit more  
confidence going into that game now. And we've  shown in the last 32 games that there's only been  
two or three wins that were quite comfortable,  but the rest of them were very, very, very hard  
work. And that's our only focus. That's my only  focus, winning a game of football. Thank you.
title: Arne Slot post-match press conference | Liverpool 2-1 West Ham United
